h1: Find your next digital nomad base
intro: Not sure where to go next? Spin the 3D globe to discover a city, then compare cost, internet speed and safety across 780+ cities. Open a destination page to see visa length and best months for that place. For a closer look, read our living guides for cities like Lisbon, Chiang Mai, Bali, Mexico City and Cape Town. You can also read our decision framework, How to Choose Your Next Nomad Base.
